title: The Episode About Singhs of Salodi Village

blocks.text: The prophecy made over Aali Singh's household comes painfully true when the first twin is killed and the second also dies, binding grief to the mysterious logic of a shared destiny. Banda summons the father to retaliate, but Aali Singh refuses to lash out blindly and accepts that the appointed span of life has ended.

That response leads not to further revenge but to blessing. Banda then blesses him with another pair of twin sons, turning the page from bereavement into renewed lineage and affirming that grace can follow even the sharpest fulfillment of prophecy.
Because of that reversal, the page is emotionally wider than a simple marvel story. It binds death, restraint, and restoration into one compact episode before the next miracle narrative begins.
